dailyfull.why: The daily full run and its bisect

docs.why: Doc index, doc budget, code map

guard.why: The tool-call guard and the pre-push check

hookrun.why: The one hook runner behind `boot/hook.py`, and the kit header every session and subagent is given

host.why: `hosts.json` read as data, the host contract and content contract types, agent names, the session mark

hubclient.why: Talking to the hub server on this machine

kitlib-root.why: The loose files at the top of `kitlib/`

ledger.why: The rulings ledger and the rulebooks (the standing rules); the owner's pending-steps file

lockui.why: The schedule window's model and actions, over `lock.api` only

mcpwire.why: The stdio JSON-RPC wires the MCP servers and the host adapters share

platform.why: Every operating-system call, behind one contract (`api`) with a complete Windows backend and a complete Linux backend

pluginsource.why: The kit's export of pushed main

pmstart.why: The PM watcher and the session starts

pmwatch.why: The PM watcher and the session starts

preflight.why: The start-of-task picture of one checkout

records.why: A repository's records outside its checkouts

reviewpack.why: Everything a reviewer needs about a branch, and the quality signals

schedtask.why: The kit's scheduled tasks on either OS

strayrestore.why: Discard a main-checkout stray that a branch tip already holds

syncbase.why: Merge the named main commit into a branch and check the result

tools.why: The `tools/` command lines; `tools/_host.py` is the one place a tool imports a host adapter

verdict.why: One judgement rule for a tool that runs a tool and prints its verdict
